fields.Name: T177 - API Key List Status Filter Tabs
fields.Description: Tests the custom filter-tab code (setFilter + Stats counts + FilteredKeys) in the hand-built API key grid, a different code path from the generic entity grid's status filter.

InputDefinition.goal: Assume you are already logged in at http://localhost:4200. Switch to the Admin application via the application switcher dropdown next to the logo, open 'Identity & Access', and select the 'API Keys' sub-section. From the overview, click 'View All Keys' (or a KPI card) to reach the list view. The list shows filter tabs across the top: All, Active, Expiring Soon, Expired, Never Used, Revoked, each with a count. Click the 'Active' tab, then the 'Revoked' tab, and observe that the grid responds — the visible key rows change to match the selected filter (or a clear no-match/empty state appears when a category has zero keys). Success is the grid responding to the tab selection. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: The API key list view renders with filter tabs (All / Active / Expiring Soon / Expired / Never Used / Revoked) each showing a count
Selecting a different filter tab narrows the visible key rows to that category OR shows a valid no-results/empty state for that category
The active tab is visually highlighted after clicking
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
